Import raster data from the EEA Air Quality Download Service API

Source: R/get_eea_raster.R
get-raster.Rd

These functions are wrappers for the 'Raster' endpoints of the European Environment Agency's Air Quality Download Service API.

  • get_eea_raster_files() downloads a zip file containing a GeoTIFF file for each hour and pollutant, named like "NO2_2024010100.tiff". The hour in each file name is in UTC.

  • get_eea_raster_async() prepares this in the background; the function returns an URL in which the file to be downloaded will be generated.

Usage

get_eea_raster_files(
  country = NULL,
  city = NULL,
  pollutants = NULL,
  datetime_start = Sys.Date() - 10,
  datetime_end = Sys.Date(),
  email = NULL,
  output_format = "zip",
  file = tempfile(fileext = paste0(".", output_format))
)

get_eea_raster_async(
  country = NULL,
  city = NULL,
  pollutants = NULL,
  datetime_start = Sys.Date() - 10,
  datetime_end = Sys.Date(),
  email = NULL,
  output_format = "zip"
)

Arguments

country

A single country code from import_eea_countries().

city

A single city in the given country from import_eea_cities(modelled = TRUE) (currently, only the country's capital city is available). If NULL, data for the entire country will be imported.

pollutants

A vector of pollutant notations from import_eea_pollutants(), ignoring case. Forecast rasters are available for "NO2", "O3", "PM10" and "PM2.5".

datetime_start, datetime_end

Start and end date times, provided as POSIXct, Date or integer R objects.

  • A POSIXct represents an exact instant, and its timezone is respected.

  • A Date represents a whole day; datetime_end includes all of the given day, meaning providing the same Date to each will return a day of data.

  • An integer represents a whole year; datetime_end includes all of the given year, meaning providing the same integer to each will return a year of data.

The forecast rasters are in UTC, so Date and integer inputs define days and years in UTC.

email

Optional field to identify the user who make the download and improve the communication if problems are detected.

output_format

One of "zip" or "tiff". Note that, at the time of writing, the API appears to return a zip file regardless of this value.

file

The file to write the downloaded file to; should ideally end in ".zip" or ".tiff", matching output_format. Defaults to a temporary file using tempfile(). Only used in get_eea_raster_files().

Value

One of:

  • get_eea_raster_files(): the file argument - the path to the downloaded ZIP file.

  • get_eea_raster_async(): a path to the URL at which the ZIP file will be made available.
